issues.description: Method return type mismatch for SealSaloon.checkOrderReady(): The problem statement UML and method list declare checkOrderReady() as returning void (problem_statement.md line 32). The solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java) declares public boolean checkOrderReady() (signature at line 20). This discrepancy can confuse students about the expected signature and return contract and may cause automated comparisons or tests that rely on the signature to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the signature consistent across artifacts. Either change the solution method signature to public void checkOrderReady() and remove the boolean return (preserving its internal logic and printing behavior), or update the problem statement and UML to declare checkOrderReady(): boolean so students implement the boolean-returning method. Prefer changing the solution to void if the intent in the specification is to have a void utility method called for side effects only; otherwise update the specification accordingly.
